n5a1dc56425.headline: NSE IPO Process Begins With OFS Notice, Shareholders Eligible Before June 15 Can Participate Until April 27
n5a1dc56425.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India has begun its IPO process with an offer-for-sale notice. Shareholders holding shares before June 15, 2025 can apply until April 27, 2026, with pricing set by book-building.
n5a1dc56425.why: The National Stock Exchange is one of India's main securities exchanges, and its listing would be among the country's largest public share offers.

nb2ba41deb1.headline: Correction: Outcome of Subscription to Coop Pank AS Unsecured Subordinated Bonds
nb2ba41deb1.summary: Estonian lender Coop Pank has published the outcome of its subscription for unsecured subordinated bonds. The notice also corrects the percentage of offer allocation stated in point 4.
nb2ba41deb1.why: Coop Pank is an Estonian commercial bank, and subordinated bonds are debt that ranks below senior obligations, so their terms matter to bank capital and bondholders.

n03181387a3.headline: Johnson Smith pushed food security, trade reform at WTO talks
n03181387a3.summary: Jamaica's foreign minister Kamina Johnson Smith called for food security for Net Food-Importing Developing Countries at the WTO's 14th Ministerial Conference, held March 26-29.
n03181387a3.why: The World Trade Organization sets global trade rules, and its negotiations affect tariffs, agricultural trade and food import costs for developing economies.

n0d506d35bd.headline: US stocks swing through another shaky day as oil prices keep climbing
n0d506d35bd.summary: U.S. stocks swung through another shaky session as oil prices kept rising amid uncertainty over when the war with Iran could end.
n0d506d35bd.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark for large U.S. equities, and oil prices feed directly into inflation expectations, corporate costs and energy-sector earnings.
n0d506d35bd.why_moved: The input says oil kept climbing on uncertainty about when the Iran war could end, which pushed U.S. stocks to swing during the session.

nb26a8ca2a0.headline: A youth-led push for change threatens Orbán's 16-year rule in Hungary's elections
nb26a8ca2a0.summary: Two weeks before pivotal elections, young voters are rallying behind Péter Magyar's Tisza party, posing the strongest challenge to Prime Minister Viktor Orbán in years.
nb26a8ca2a0.why: Hungary's government sets fiscal and regulatory policy affecting its forint currency, government bonds and EU funding relations, so elections matter to investors.

nefcbc39520.headline: National Cabinet announces fuel security plan
nefcbc39520.summary: The Commonwealth, states and territories agreed a four-stage fuel security plan as the Middle East war continues and fuel price concerns grow across Australia.
nefcbc39520.why: Fuel security policy affects supply resilience, pricing and the wider energy cost base for the economy. Australia relies heavily on imported refined fuel.

ne1e00bd595.headline: Agriculture Minister calls for capping the commercial margin on all agri-food products
ne1e00bd595.summary: Agriculture Minister Florin Barbu called for capping the commercial margin on all agri-food products at 20% for six months. He spoke on Monday in Bacau.
ne1e00bd595.why: Retail margin caps change pricing and profitability for food retailers and distributors. Such measures are a direct form of government price intervention in consumer markets.

nbb1a40ec4c.headline: Audit Office: Czechia struggling to stabilize public finances as debt continues to rise
nbb1a40ec4c.summary: The Czech Audit Office says the country is struggling to stabilise public finances as debt keeps rising. The assessment comes from the state audit body.
nbb1a40ec4c.why: Rising public debt affects government bond yields, borrowing costs and fiscal policy. Investors in Czech sovereign debt and the koruna watch these trends closely.

n0345f4149e.headline: Inquiry fires up chances of raising gas export taxes
n0345f4149e.summary: A parliamentary committee will report on Australia's gas export regime before the budget. The inquiry signals the government may consider raising gas export taxes.
n0345f4149e.why: Australia is one of the world's largest LNG exporters, so changes to its gas export rules affect global LNG supply and pricing.

na34f9db071.headline: Sorin Grindeanu presents scenarios for PSD's exit from government
na34f9db071.summary: PSD leader Sorin Grindeanu said the Social Democrats are analysing three scenarios for the party's future in government. The options are keeping the current formula, reconfiguring the coalition or moving into opposition.
na34f9db071.why: Coalition changes in Romania can affect fiscal policy, budget discipline and the government's standing with investors and EU funding.

ned9e765449.headline: Global oil majors renew exploration push
ned9e765449.summary: Global energy companies are refocusing on finding new oil and gas sources, executives said at the CERAWeek conference in Houston. The shift ends years of underinvestment in exploration.
ned9e765449.why: Exploration spending by majors shapes long-term oil and gas supply, which feeds into commodity prices and energy-sector earnings.

n99c4f0548f.headline: Latest travel updates from British Airways, Emirates, Qatar Airways & more
n99c4f0548f.summary: British Airways, Qatar Airways, Emirates and Qantas have cancelled or suspended flights to several airports amid the Iran conflict. Travel updates from major carriers are being issued.
n99c4f0548f.why: Airlines are highly sensitive to airspace closures and fuel costs, which affect their revenues and share prices.

nf7d534180d.headline: Markets Today: Geopolitical premium drives markets, focus shifts to Fed and US jobs report
nf7d534180d.summary: Middle East conflict has driven oil prices higher and the dollar to a 10-month high, while Asian stocks plunged. Investors are now focusing on the Fed and the US jobs report.
nf7d534180d.why: Oil and the dollar act as key channels for geopolitical risk, shaping inflation expectations, central bank policy and equity valuations worldwide.
nf7d534180d.why_moved: Middle East conflict pushed oil higher and lifted the dollar to a 10-month high, while a geopolitical risk premium weighed on Asian stocks.

n7a25d63496.headline: Adequate fertiliser stocks despite West Asia crisis, supply strains: Govt
n7a25d63496.summary: The Indian government said fertiliser stocks stand at about 180 lakh metric tonnes, compared with 147 lakh tonnes a year ago. Supply strains from the West Asia crisis remain a concern.
n7a25d63496.why: India is a major fertiliser importer, so supply shocks in West Asia affect farm input costs and crop economics.

nbf32b76eb6.headline: Fill 'er up: electric trucks plug into charging network
nbf32b76eb6.summary: Oil and gas price surges are shifting investor focus toward macro risks. The move is lifting equity correlations and reshaping volatility expectations.
nbf32b76eb6.why: Energy price shocks feed into inflation and interest-rate expectations, which affect equity valuations across sectors. Volatility and correlation shifts change how portfolios are hedged.

n1ac2bfcaf2.headline: Embattled motorists win bowser relief as taxes slashed
n1ac2bfcaf2.summary: The government moved to cut taxes on petrol and diesel as the Middle East war sends global fuel prices higher. The relief targets motorists facing higher pump prices.
n1ac2bfcaf2.why: Fuel excise taxes make up a large share of pump prices, so changes to them directly affect consumer fuel costs and inflation. Fiscal costs also matter for the government budget.

n15d3f061e2.headline: Iran's strike wounded over a dozen U.S. personnel and hit valuable jets in Saudi Arabia
n15d3f061e2.summary: NPR confirmed at least two US E-3 Sentry aircraft were damaged and over a dozen US service members injured in an Iranian missile and drone attack in Saudi Arabia on Friday.
n15d3f061e2.why: Saudi Arabia is one of the world's largest oil producers, so attacks in the kingdom raise supply-risk concerns for global energy markets.

nc3e48f2ecf.headline: Lok Sabha Approves IBC Amendment Bill To Speed Insolvency Resolution Process Nationwide
nc3e48f2ecf.summary: The Lok Sabha approved the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (Amendment) Bill, 2025 on March 30. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said it includes a 14-day deadline to admit cases and penalties for misuse.
nc3e48f2ecf.why: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code governs corporate insolvency in India, shaping creditor recovery and restructuring timelines for lenders and investors.

n0456067c66.headline: Debit, credit surcharge fees scrapped despite strong business opposition
n0456067c66.summary: Debit and credit card surcharges are being scrapped despite strong opposition from businesses. Consumers are estimated to be paying $1.6 billion of a total $1.8 billion in card surcharges.
n0456067c66.why: Card surcharges are fees merchants add to card payments, so their removal affects retailer margins and the payments industry. Changes to payment fee rules are watched by investors in banks and payment networks.

n61702adbad.headline: Trump again threatens widespread destruction in Iran if a deal is not reached 'shortly'
n61702adbad.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump on Monday threatened widespread destruction of Iran's energy resources and other vital infrastructure. He said a deal should be reached shortly.
n61702adbad.why: Iran is a major oil producer, and threats to its energy infrastructure raise the risk of supply disruption in the Gulf. Crude prices and global equity markets react strongly to Middle East escalation.
n61702adbad.why_moved: Threats against Iran's energy resources and vital infrastructure raise the risk of disruption to Gulf oil supply, a driver of crude prices.

n2d3ad12ed5.headline: Indian Rupee falls quickly back to Friday's record lows despite another RBI intervention
n2d3ad12ed5.summary: The rupee gave back gains from the Reserve Bank of India's latest intervention and returned to Friday's record lows against the US dollar. Bearish pressure on the currency persists.
n2d3ad12ed5.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects India's import costs, including oil, and the returns that foreign investors earn on Indian assets. The RBI manages volatility by intervening in the currency market.
n2d3ad12ed5.why_moved: The rupee reversed the gains from the RBI's intervention and slid back to record lows, as bearish pressure on the currency persisted.

n1b20cd2da9.headline: Britons turn to solar power to ‘insulate’ against oil and gas chaos, says E.On
n1b20cd2da9.summary: UK electricity supplier E.ON said solar sales rose 62 percent this month compared with the previous month. The company attributed the trend to households seeking protection from oil and gas volatility.
n1b20cd2da9.why: E.ON is a major European energy supplier and network operator, so shifts in household energy demand affect its retail business.

nd417f1d543.headline: Oil prices surge as Houthi attacks escalate Middle East conflict
nd417f1d543.summary: Brent crude rose to $115.77 a barrel and WTI increased to $101.51 by 09:33 GMT as Houthi attacks escalated the Middle East conflict.
nd417f1d543.why: Brent and WTI are the main benchmarks for global crude oil prices, so supply threats in the Middle East feed directly into fuel, transport and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Brent rose to $115.77 a barrel as the escalating conflict raised supply concerns.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nd417f1d543.why_moved: Houthi attacks escalating the Middle East conflict raised fears of disrupted oil supply, pushing both benchmarks higher.

na293def9fd.headline: Won Fall May Prompt Action, Korea's $1 Trillion Pension CEO Says
na293def9fd.summary: The won's weakness against the dollar during recent market turmoil may require action to stabilise it, the head of South Korea's largest pension fund said. Kim Sung-joo spoke in Seoul.
na293def9fd.why: The National Pension Service is one of the world's largest pension funds, and its currency exposure matters for Korean and global markets. Won moves affect dollar-denominated returns and capital flows.

n2997824eba.headline: Euro area economic sentiment eases in March as Middle East conflict stokes inflation fears
n2997824eba.summary: Euro area economic sentiment eased in March as the Middle East conflict stoked inflation fears. The outlook for the European economy is becoming more uncertain.
n2997824eba.why: Economic sentiment surveys are a leading indicator of consumer and business activity, which central banks watch when setting interest rates. Euro area data shape the outlook for the euro and European equities.

nb85d241d49.headline: NZ pursuing fuel options 'with urgency': Luxon
nb85d241d49.summary: New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon said the government is pursuing fuel options with urgency.
nb85d241d49.why: New Zealand imports nearly all of its refined fuel, so supply options directly affect petrol prices, transport costs and inflation.

n8866609dc0.headline: Brent heads for record monthly jump as Houthi attacks widen Gulf conflict
n8866609dc0.summary: Brent is on track for a record monthly rise after Yemen's Houthis launched their first attacks on Israel over the weekend, widening the US-Israel war.
n8866609dc0.why: Brent is the main global benchmark for crude oil, so Middle East supply risks quickly transmit into fuel, transport and inflation expectations worldwide.
n8866609dc0.why_moved: Houthi attacks on Israel widened the US-Israel war in the Gulf region, raising supply-disruption risk for crude oil. Oil prices extended gains on the news.

n9cbabf8c60.headline: USDJPY falls below the key 160.00 handle amid intensifying verbal intervention
n9cbabf8c60.summary: The USDJPY pair pulled back from the 160.00 level as verbal intervention gave the yen some reprieve.
n9cbabf8c60.why: The yen is Japan's currency, and the dollar-yen rate influences Japanese import costs, exporters' earnings and the policy stance of Japanese authorities.
n9cbabf8c60.why_moved: Verbal intervention by Japanese authorities against yen weakness pulled USD/JPY back from the 160.00 level. Traders reacted to the risk of official action to support the currency.

n9ab194c1dd.headline: Sony suspends certain sales amid shortages without a timeline for them to return
n9ab194c1dd.summary: Sony has suspended sales of certain products amid shortages, with no timeline for their return. The stock is unavailable at its Japanese store and shows as unavailable in the US.
n9ab194c1dd.why: Sony Group is a Japan-based electronics, gaming and entertainment conglomerate, so supply disruptions affect its consumer electronics and gaming revenue.

nac31a3dffb.headline: S.Korea exports to rise most in nearly 5 years, imports also higher on Mideast conflict
nac31a3dffb.summary: South Korea's March exports probably rose at the strongest pace in nearly five years on a boom in chip demand fuelled by AI investment, though the Iran war also lifted imports.
nac31a3dffb.why: South Korea is a major exporter of semiconductors, so its trade data is a closely watched gauge of global chip and AI hardware demand.

nd9437bfcb4.headline: DAX FLASH:  Downward momentum continues toward 22,000 level
nd9437bfcb4.summary: The Dax is expected to open lower on Monday, starting a shortened trading week ahead of Easter. Broker IG pegged the German benchmark lower before the Xetra open.
nd9437bfcb4.why: The DAX is Germany's benchmark index of the largest listed companies, a key gauge of European equity sentiment.

impacts.name: DAX
impacts.why: The benchmark index is expected to open lower on pre-market indications.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nb5cad57ea3.headline: Bursa Malaysia, HKEX unveil joint large-cap index as they seek to deepen market links
nb5cad57ea3.summary: Bursa Malaysia and HKEX have unveiled a joint large-cap index. It tracks 30 Malaysian blue chips and 30 Hong Kong-listed large-cap stocks.
nb5cad57ea3.why: Bursa Malaysia is Malaysia's national stock exchange, and HKEX runs Hong Kong's exchange, so a joint index links two regional markets for investors.

nc27e3a0954.headline: Vietnam sets low bar for crypto taxes to pull trading onshore
nc27e3a0954.summary: Vietnam has set a transaction-based levy of 0.1% on crypto trading. The state says the simple structure aims to ensure transparency of investor cash flows and bring trading onshore.
nc27e3a0954.why: Vietnam has restricted offshore crypto exchanges, so tax and licensing rules determine how much crypto trading is conducted on domestic platforms.

n4b7c9795ae.headline: British construction industry 'grinding to a halt' in Iran war building meltdown
n4b7c9795ae.summary: Industry chiefs say the UK building industry is grinding to a halt because of supply chain problems and higher fuel costs caused by the Middle East conflict.
n4b7c9795ae.why: Construction is a large part of the UK economy, and input costs and supply constraints affect activity, employment and inflation.

na0dbd3caae.headline: As family feud erupts, Lopez stocks lose ground
na0dbd3caae.summary: Share prices of some Lopez-led companies listed on the Philippine Stock Exchange fell as a family feud erupted. The input gives no further detail on the dispute.
na0dbd3caae.why: The Lopez group controls several listed Philippine companies, so family disputes over control can affect investor confidence in those firms.

n2f8af91d66.headline: BSP easing cycle over; oil crisis clouds outlook
n2f8af91d66.summary: Analysts say the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas may have ended its easing cycle, signalling a prolonged policy pause as inflation risks rise amid the Middle East conflict.
n2f8af91d66.why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas sets the Philippines' policy rate, which influences lending costs, the peso and bond yields.

nb5594b18a9.headline: Peso sinks to new low, stocks tumble anew
nb5594b18a9.summary: Philippine financial markets opened the week weak, with the peso hitting another record low. Stocks tumbled as escalating Middle East tensions rattled investors.
nb5594b18a9.why: The Philippine peso is the local currency used for trade and debt in the Philippines, and the Philippine Stock Exchange index tracks the country's listed companies.
nb5594b18a9.why_moved: Escalating Middle East tensions drove risk-off sentiment, weighing on the peso and local equities.
